name: odoo
description: Direct access to mySMB's own Odoo ERP instance via Odoo's native MCP server — contacts and calendar. A separate integration from odoo-extract (which is Odoo's unrelated paid OCR service).

connection.instructions: This connects to a community MCP Server app installed on mySMB's own Odoo instance (not a stock Odoo feature — no official Odoo docs page exists for it). In Odoo, open the app's "Save your API Key" dialog and generate a new key — it's shown exactly once, so copy it immediately and paste it below.

fields.name: ODOO_API_KEY
fields.label: Odoo API Key
fields.helpText: Generated from Odoo's own "Save your API Key" dialog. Grants full access to your Odoo account — treat it like a password. Stored encrypted in your personal credentials vault.
